UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this with your current role or account access.
CSRF_REJECTED: This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: This item does not exist or you do not have access to it.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are not valid. Correct the highlighted fields and try again.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request is missing its safety key. Reload the page and try again.
PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: The request is missing the version it applies to. Reload the page and try again.
VERSION_CONFLICT: This item changed while you were viewing it. Review the latest version before deciding.
STATE_CONFLICT: This action is no longer available because the item's status changed.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request key was already used for a different request. Nothing was changed.
REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: The original request is still being processed. Wait a moment — do not submit again.
AGREEMENT_INACTIVE: No effective signed agreement covers this action. Contact your bank relationship manager.
MODULE_DISABLED: This service is not enabled in your bank agreement. Contact your bank relationship manager.
MODULE_UNAVAILABLE: This service is not available in this release.
TRANSACTION_TYPE_DISABLED: This transaction type is not enabled in your bank agreement.
ACCOUNT_NOT_ALLOWED: This account cannot be used for this action under your agreement or access rights.
RAIL_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: The bank has not configured a ceiling for this payment rail yet, so it cannot be used.
RAIL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The amount is above the ceiling for this payment rail.
MODULE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The amount is above the limit for this service.
CORPORATE_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This would exceed your company's daily limit.
CORPORATE_MONTHLY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This would exceed your company's monthly limit.
USER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This would exceed your personal limit.
BATCH_ROW_CAP_EXCEEDED: The file has more rows than your agreement allows in one batch.
SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You created this proposal, so another person must review it.
APPROVAL_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: No approval rule covers this amount, so it cannot be submitted.
REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED: The terms changed after approval. The proposal must be reviewed and approved again.
INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The available balance is not enough for the amount and fee.
NAME_MISMATCH: The name does not match the account. Correct the beneficiary before paying.
NAME_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: The name check is temporarily unavailable. No payment was created. Try again.
EXECUTION_WINDOW_CLOSED: The execution window for this rail is closed for that time.
STATUS_UNRESOLVED: The result is still being checked with the bank. Do not submit again.
RETRY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Only items that definitely failed before posting can be retried.
IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large or has too many rows.
UNSUPPORTED_FILE: This file type or template is not supported. Use the current CSV or XLSX template.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE: The banking system is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was confirmed. Quote the support reference.
NETWORK: The connection was lost before we received an answer. We are checking the result — do not submit again.

fields.amountFormat: Enter an amount using digits and a dot for decimals, for example 125.000.
fields.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
fields.amountDecimals: LYD amounts have at most three decimal places.
fields.reasonLength: Give a reason between 3 and 500 characters.
fields.phone: Enter a Libyan mobile number in international format, for example +218 91 234 5678.
